key_insight: M$^3$-Gen generates biologically coherent gene expression profiles from histopathology images and clinical metadata using an interpretable multimodal GAN framework.
clinical_relevance: This could help fill missing or costly molecular data in multimodal cancer research by inferring gene expression from routinely available clinical and pathology inputs.
method: Learns a shared latent representation from clinical variables and histopathology images with contrastive learning.
Uses the paired embeddings to condition a GAN that generates gene expression profiles.
Adds attention-based multimodal fusion to highlight image regions that influenced specific outputs.
evidence_signal: On the TCGA dataset, the model produced realistic and functionally meaningful gene expression profiles according to the abstract.
watch_item: Results are based on a retrospective dataset, so external validation and careful assessment of generalizability are needed before broader use.
paper_title: M$^3$-Gen: Interpretable Multimodal Generation of Gene Expression Profiles Using Clinical and Imaging Data
